title: Inquest into jail-cell death
article: An inquest will be conducted into the 2011 death of a man who was found unresponsive in an RCMP jail cell.

Surinder Singh Mahli, 58, had been in lock-up under the watch of Surrey RCMP when he was found unresponsive on Dec. 26, 2011. He was then taken to Surrey Memorial Hospital but died days later on Dec. 30.

Coroner Margaret Janzen and a jury will hear evidence from witnesses to determined the circumstances and facts relating to Mahli's death, after which a number of recommendations could be made to prevent similar deaths in the future.
The public inquest will begin Jan. 20, 2014, and wrap on Jan. 24, at the Coroners Court in Burnaby.
